intro.description: This tour takes about ten minutes. You will create a capability file, use content assist, and read the validation feedback in plain language.

item.title: Open the example workspace
item.description: In the Project Explorer open demo/example-workspace. It already contains a small MNC model, one capability and one activity flow.

item.title: Create a capability file
item.description: Right-click the example folder and choose New > File. Name it MyCapability.cap. The KIDE capability editor opens automatically.

item.title: Use the templates
item.description: Press Ctrl+Space on the empty line and pick the capability template. A complete skeleton with interface, control capabilities and outcomes is inserted; press Tab to move between the placeholders.

item.title: Bind an interface
item.description: After compatible component interface press Ctrl+Space again. Only interfaces declared in the MNC model are offered, so the reference is always valid.

item.title: Read the validation feedback
item.description: Type a command name that the interface does not declare. The editor underlines it and the Problems view explains which interface was expected. Press Ctrl+1 for the quick fix that removes the item.

item.title: See it as a diagram
item.description: Open the Sirius representation in com.model.domain.activity.design to see the same model drawn with the KIDE visual language.
